note: PREVIOUS-DAY ABSENCE NOTIFICATION. SmartPRS 2's AbsenceService (F10) runs each morning, finds every active employee with no punch, no approved leave, no holiday and no weekly off, and notifies them with a link to regularise. These are its defaults, DECLARED: a tenant turns it on and chooses who is told through the screen, and the choice is versioned in module_customisations under the key below. It ships OFF, as SmartPRS 2 does: an absence mail sent before the device import has landed tells forty people they were absent on a day they worked.
what_absent_means: A day is ABSENT when the published attendance rules (config/attendance-rules.json) say so for a day with no punches — the same verdict the muster shows and payroll pays from. This file does not decide it; it only decides who is told.
